params.segmenter: kraken blla.mlmodel (package default), blla.segment(device=cuda:0), full-resolution JPEG
params.pitch: median spacing of consecutive baselines among segments wider than half the widest segment
params.binarize: cv2.adaptiveThreshold GAUSSIAN_C, blockSize=51, C=18, THRESH_BINARY_INV; opening 3x3 (1 iter)
params.mixture: 3-component Gaussian EM on log(gap px) for gaps >= 3 px (stroke / glyph / word gaps; 1-2 px gaps are stroke breaks); threshold = posterior-0.5 crossing between the two upper components; quantile init, sd floor 0.15, 300 iters
params.margin_filter: drop kraken segments narrower than 0.6*pitch, or narrower than 2*pitch and lying outside the text block (x1 < L + 0.5*pitch or x0 > R - 0.5*pitch; L/R = 10th/90th pct of x0/x1 of segments wider than 5*pitch): margin stars, folio numbers, quire marks
